title: Stronger tree baselines with equal labels and additional benign training data
support_design: Equal-label support is identical to the original E1 support for each seed. The abundant-benign support retains all original 192 rows and adds 992 NormalTraffic fit rows by SHA256(tag|seed|fingerprint). Attack supports are unchanged.
query_design: All 30,787 original development-test rows, in original array order. No sampling or filtering by predictions or outcomes. Calibration data are neither fitted nor evaluated in this follow-up.
hyperparameter_selection: Three-fold stratified CV macro-F1 using only selected training supports, with fold-specific median imputation. Twelve XGBoost, twelve LightGBM, and six Random Forest candidates are fixed before any follow-up fit. No early stopping, threshold search, or retuning after results.
family_selection: Maximum inner-CV macro-F1; ties prefer xgboost then lightgbm then random_forest
primary_comparison: Existing original-budget TabICL versus the wider-CV-selected GBDT using matching seeds, support fingerprints, class order, and query rows. Full-test claims require full-test TabICL predictions. Any comparison to the earlier CPU prescreen must restrict the saved tree predictions to the exact prescreen query and use its same weights.
secondary_comparison: CV-selected best of all three tree families, plus every family individually. Abundant-benign trees are a deployment challenge with 992 additional training labels, not an equal-label foundation comparison.
decision_scope: Descriptive follow-up only. Report paired macro-F1 differences and InitialCompromise/DataExfiltration recall differences without selecting models or thresholds on test outcomes. This runner reports tree results and training-CV choices, not a foundation success verdict.
preprocessing: Median imputation with empty columns retained; fitted independently inside every training CV fold and then on the full selected support for final prediction. No scaling or feature fitting on calibration/test data.
execution: Freeze source and protocol before model fits. Private prefit receipt binds data, code, versions, supports, folds and the complete query roster. Every started cell has an immutable receipt; incomplete cells are preserved and require a fresh output directory. Completed cells resume only when all bindings and artifact hashes match.
limitations: Exact feature duplicate removal does not remove all correlated or near-duplicate flows
InitialCompromise has only15 test and14 calibration examples
Balanced training budgets alter class priors
Source stage labels are accepted for this benchmark, not independently human-adjudicated
No early-warning, next-stage forecasting or actor-attribution claim
Broad foundation-model IDS and conformalized foundation IDS already have prior art; novelty remains unestablished
A negative outcome is possible and will be reported
Earlier development outcomes were known when this follow-up was designed; this is not a new untouched holdout
Additional benign-label acquisition cost is counted even if benign labels might be operationally easier to obtain
Shared test rows and fitting pool make ten seeds dependent; no seed-based confidence interval or independent replication claim

same_budget_primary_gate.reference: Reuse the original E1 descriptive development gate
same_budget_primary_gate.interpretation: Follow-up descriptive result only; not an untouched holdout or independent confirmation

batch_completion: All 60 cells: ten seeds, two conditions, and all three tree families including Random Forest. Primary comparison eligibility requires both GBDT families and matching full-query original TabICL for all ten seeds.
abundant_benign_decision: Descriptive unequal-budget challenge only; no equal-budget foundation winner claim.
